story: Lake Ahquabi State Park is located in Warren County, Iowa, United States, and features a 115-acre reservoir. Ahquabi means resting place in the Fox language. The park is six miles south of Indianola and 22 miles south of Des Moines.
matters: The park includes a surrounding watershed and buffer wetlands that help improve water quality by reducing sediments and nutrients reaching the lake.
name: Lake Ahquabi State Park
